UIDAI Chief Highlights Daily Cyberattacks, Explores AI for Authentication

UIDAI Chief Neelkanth Mishra stated that the organization faces approximately 100 cyberattacks daily. He also indicated that UIDAI is exploring the delegation of authentication processes to agents, potentially utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) and quantum safeguarding measures. This shift aims to move away from human-based authentication methods.
